details.user_story: As a Developer, I need a centralized cloud database to store user data and swing analysis results so that data persists across sessions and devices.
details.context: Currently, data is likely transient or local. We need a robust relational DB (Supabase/Postgres) to handle the relationships between Users, Videos, and Analysis Data.
acceptance_criteria: PostgreSQL instance is provisioned and accessible via connection string.
Schema migration scripts created for tables: 'users', 'swings', 'analysis_results'.
Backend can successfully read/write to the database.
Environment variables for DB credentials are secured in .env.
technical_details: Tech: Supabase or standard PostgreSQL.
Schema: 'swings' table needs foreign key to 'users', and JSONB column for 'skeletal_data'.
Tooling: Use Alembic or Prisma for migrations.
edge_cases: Connection Timeout: Handle DB cold starts (common with free tier Supabase).
Data Integrity: Ensure cascading deletes are configured (if a user is deleted, their swings go too).

details.user_story: As a User, I want to delete old or accidental swing uploads so that I can keep my library clean.
details.context: Users need control over their data. This requires a destructive action that removes the record from the DB and the associated video file from storage.
acceptance_criteria: UI provides a 'Delete' button on the Swing Detail view.
User is prompted with a confirmation modal before deletion.
Backend removes the database row AND the associated video file from cloud storage.
List view automatically refreshes to remove the deleted item.
technical_details: Endpoint: DELETE /swings/{id}
Storage: Ensure cloud storage deletion (e.g., S3/Supabase Storage delete call).
edge_cases: Orphaned Files: If DB delete succeeds but Storage delete fails, log an error for cleanup.
Concurrency: User tries to delete a file while it is currently being analyzed.

details.user_story: As a Player/Coach, I want the app to automatically detect my body joints from a video upload, so that I can receive instant bio-mechanical analysis without manually marking up the video.
details.context: This is the core engine of DiamondMind. We need to ingest raw video footage and output a structured time-series of skeletal coordinates. This data will power the Stick-Figure Overlay and Swing Analysis.
acceptance_criteria: System accepts video input (MP4/MOV) from the local device.
System extracts 33 key body landmarks (specifically shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, ankles) for every frame.
Output is generated in a standardized JSON format (see Tech Details).
Processing speed is < 5 seconds for a standard 5-second swing clip on the GPU.
Low-confidence frames (where body parts are hidden) are flagged or interpolated.
technical_details: Model: MediaPipe Pose (Google) or YOLOv8-Pose. Recommendation: MediaPipe for speed on mobile edge devices.
Input: Raw video frame buffer (RGB).
Output: JSON Schema with frame_index, timestamp_ms, and landmarks (x, y, visibility).
edge_cases: Occlusion: The bat crossing the body or the camera angle hiding the back arm.
Motion Blur: Fast bat speeds blurring the hands.
Multiple People: Ensure the model tracks the *primary* subject (the batter) if other players are in the background.

details.user_story: As a Coach, I want to see a stick-figure skeleton overlaid on the video so that I can visually verify body positions.
details.context: Visual validation of DM-12. We need to draw lines connecting the extracted coordinate points on top of the video player.
acceptance_criteria: Video player renders SVG or Canvas layer on top of video.
Skeleton lines connect correct joints (e.g., shoulder to elbow, elbow to wrist).
Overlay stays synchronized with video playback.
User can toggle overlay ON/OFF.
technical_details: Frontend: React Native Skia or SVG.
Logic: Map normalized (0-1) coordinates from DM-12 JSON to screen pixel dimensions.
edge_cases: Aspect Ratio Mismatch: Ensure lines align correctly even if video is cropped or scaled.
Missing Data: Handle frames where DM-12 returned 'null' for a joint (don't draw random lines to 0,0).

details.user_story: As a Player practicing alone, I want to hear the coaching feedback via audio so I don't have to look at the screen between swings.
details.context: Accessibility and usability feature. Converts the AI's text analysis into spoken word.
acceptance_criteria: App reads the 'Coach Feedback' summary aloud.
Audio playback controls (Play/Pause/Stop).
Configurable voice settings (optional).
Works in background (stretch goal).
technical_details: API: ElevenLabs API (High quality) or Native OS TTS (Expo Speech).
Trigger: Auto-play after analysis or manual button press.
edge_cases: Silent Mode: Respect device silent/do-not-disturb settings.
Interruption: Pause speech if a phone call comes in or user navigates away.

details.user_story: As a User, I want to create a profile with my age and height so that the AI can calibrate its analysis for me.
details.context: Personalization. 10u players have different metrics than Varsity. We need to store this metadata.
acceptance_criteria: User can sign up/login (Auth).
Profile settings page allows editing: Name, Age Group (10u/14u/Varsity), Handedness (L/R).
Backend uses 'Age Group' to select the correct AI Persona (linked to DM-16).
technical_details: Auth Provider: Supabase Auth or Firebase.
Storage: 'users' table columns: id, email, skill_level, height_cm.
edge_cases: Missing Data: Handle cases where a user hasn't set an age group (Default to '14u').
Session Expiry: Gracefully handle token expiration during app usage.

details.user_story: As a User, I want to access the app via a web browser so I can view my stats on a laptop.
details.context: Since we use Expo, web support is built-in, but needs configuration for responsiveness and navigation.
acceptance_criteria: App renders correctly in Chrome/Safari on Desktop.
Layout adapts to wide screens (responsive design).
Deep links work on web.
Deployable URL (Vercel).
technical_details: Expo Web: Ensure 'react-native-web' is configured.
Navigation: Verify Expo Router handles URL paths correctly.
edge_cases: CORS: Ensure Backend API allows requests from the Web domain.
Camera Access: Web browsers handle camera permissions differently than Native apps.

details.user_story: As a Mobile User, I want to install the app from the App Store so I have native performance and offline access.
details.context: Moving from development to production builds.
acceptance_criteria: Build pipeline established for iOS (IPA) and Android (APK/AAB).
App icon and splash screen configured.
Native permissions (Camera, Microphone) correctly requested in Info.plist/Manifest.
technical_details: Tooling: Expo EAS Build (preferred over Capacitor for Expo apps).
Config: app.json updates for bundle identifiers and versioning.
edge_cases: Store Rejection: Ensure 'Sign in with Apple' is present if other social logins are used (Apple Requirement).
Build Failures: Handle missing signing credentials.

details.user_story: As a Pitcher, I want to analyze my pitching mechanics so I can improve my delivery and prevent injury.
details.context: Different biomechanics than hitting. Needs a separate 'Mode' in the UI and different heuristics for the AI.
acceptance_criteria: UI toggle to switch between 'Hitting' and 'Pitching' modes.
AI evaluates specific pitching metrics: Stride Length, Arm Slot, Release Point.
Distinct System Prompt for pitching feedback.
technical_details: Reuse DM-12 (Skeleton Extraction).
New heuristic analysis module: `analyze_pitching(landmarks)`.
edge_cases: Camera Angle: Pitching is often filmed from behind the mound (Hitting is side view). AI must detect or ask for angle.
Lefties: Ensure arm slot analysis isn't inverted for left-handed pitchers.

details.user_story: As a User, I want to upload existing videos from my camera roll so I can analyze swings recorded previously.
details.context: Currently we might only support live capture. Import is critical for past analysis.
acceptance_criteria: UI opens native device file picker.
Validates file type (video) and duration (max 10s).
Uploads file to cloud storage bucket.
Triggers analysis pipeline upon success.
technical_details: Library: `expo-image-picker`.
Backend: Endpoint to accept multipart/form-data upload.
edge_cases: File Size: Reject files >50MB to prevent timeout.
Format: Handle HEVC/H.265 (iPhone default) conversion if backend only supports MP4/H.264.
